info.title: Matomo Reporting API for TagManager plugin

get.description: Get a list of all available contexts that can be used on this system. For example "web", "android", "ios"
Get a list of all available environments such as "live", "dev", "staging"

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
id	name
live	Live
dev	Dev
staging	Staging

get.description: Get a list of all available environments such as "live", "dev", "staging" with the permission to publish.

id	name
dev	Dev

get.description: Get a list of all available fire limits which can be used when creating or updating a tag.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
id	name
unlimited	Unlimited
once_page	Once per pageview
once_24hours	Once per 24 hours
once_lifetime	Once in lifetime

get.description: Get a list of all available comparisons which can be used for example as part of a trigger condition (filter) or as part of a variable lookup table.

row.name: not is lower than or equals
not is greater than or equals
not matches the regular expression (ignore case)

example.name: not is lower than or equals
not is greater than or equals
not matches the regular expression (ignore case)

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
id	name
equals	equals
not_equals	not equals
equals_exactly	equals exactly
not_equals_exactly	not equals exactly
contains	contains
not_contains	not contains
starts_with	starts with
not_starts_with	not starts with
ends_with	ends with
not_ends_with	not ends with
lower_than	is lower than
not_lower_than	not is lower than
lower_than_or_equals	is lower than or equals
not_lower_than_or_equals	not is lower than or equals
greater_than	is greater than
not_greater_than	not is greater than
greater_than_or_equals	is greater than or equals
not_greater_than_or_equals	not is greater than or equals
regexp	matches the regular expression
not_regexp	not matches the regular expression
regexp_ignore_case	matches the regular expression (ignore case)
not_regexp_ignore_case	not matches the regular expression (ignore case)
match_css_selector	matches the CSS selector
not_match_css_selector	not matches the CSS selector

get.description: Creates the default container for the given site. This container will automatically have a configured tag to track a Matomo instance and also have a trigger assigned to track a pageview when a page is being viewed.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The id of the site that the container will be created for

200.description: The ID of the created container.

get.description: Creates a new tag within the given container version.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The id of the site the given container belongs to

parameters.name: idContainer
parameters.description: The id of a container, for example "6OMh6taM"

parameters.name: idContainerVersion
parameters.description: The ID of the container version, a container may have multiple versions and the list of tags will be different per container. Therefore you need to provide the ID of the version you are referring to.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of tag you want to create, for example "Matomo".

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name this tag should have

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: A key/value pair to define values for specific parameters. For example array('parameterName' => 'value')

parameters.name: fireTriggerIds
parameters.description: A list of trigger IDs that define when this tag should be fired. A tag will be executed as soon as any of these triggers fire. At least one trigger needs to be set.

parameters.name: blockTriggerIds
parameters.description: Optional, a list of trigger IDs that block the execution of a tag. As soon as any of these triggers have been triggered, the tag will not be executed

parameters.name: fireLimit
parameters.description: Optional, limit how often the tag will be executed. For a list of available fire limits call {@link TagManager.getAvailableTagFireLimits}

parameters.name: fireDelay
parameters.description: Optional, a delay in milliseconds. If specified, instead of the tag being executed right away when a fire trigger is being triggered, the execution will be delayed.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Optional, a custom priority which defines the order in which certain tags will be executed if multiple will be triggered at once. The lower the priority is, the earlier this tag may be fired.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional, a start date to ensure the tag will be only executed after this date. Please provide the date in UTC.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional, an end date to ensure the tag will not be executed after this date. Please provide the date in UTC.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional status to set when creating the tag.

200.description: The ID of the created tag.

get.description: Exports a container version including all details such as the configured tags, triggers, and variables within this version. You can use this export to import it into a different container version for example. By default, the current draft will be exported unless you specify a specific container version.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The id of the site the given container belongs to

parameters.name: idContainer
parameters.description: The id of a container, for example "6OMh6taM"

parameters.name: idContainerVersion
parameters.description: The ID of the container version, a container may have multiple versions and the list of variable will be different per container. Therefore you need to provide the ID of the version you are referring to. If no version is provided, the current "draft" version will be used.

get.description: Import all tags, triggers, and variables from the given import. Please note that this will delete / remove the all current tags, triggers, and variables from the current draft version and then import all tags, triggers, and variables from a previously exported container version. To not lose the current draft configuration, specify a backup name so nothing gets lost in case you ever want to revert.

parameters.name: exportedContainerVersion
parameters.description: A JSON formatted string containing a previously exported container version.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The id of the site the given container belongs to

parameters.name: idContainer
parameters.description: The id of a container, for example "6OMh6taM"

parameters.name: backupName
parameters.description: If specified, a backup of the current draft will be created under this version name.

parameters.name: _isDraftRestoreCall
parameters.description: A boolean parameter to specify, if its a backup restore call to avoid nesting exception if backup version has errors

tags.name: TagManager
tags.description: API for plugin Tag Manager.  Lets you configure all your containers, create, update and delete tags, triggers, and variables. Create and publish new releases, enable and disable preview/debug mode, and much more.  Please note: A container may have several versions. The current version that a user is editing is called the "draft" version. You can get the ID of the "draft" version by calling {@link TagManager.getContainer}.
